def test_nota_privada(admin, outro, submission_ctx):

    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/private_notes", json={"note": "nota secreta"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["note"] == "nota secreta"
    detail = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()
    assert detail["summary"]["private_note"] == "nota secreta"

    # outro usuario nao ve a nota
    detail_outro = outro.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()
    assert detail_outro["summary"]["private_note"] == ""

    # atualizacao nao cria outra nota
    admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/private_notes", json={"note": "nota alterada"})
    detail = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()

def test_visualizacoes(admin, outro, submission_ctx):
    _, sub = submission_ctx
    assert admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/view").status_code == 200
    first = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/view").json()
    assert first
    admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/view")
    second = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/view").json()
    assert len(second) == len(first)  # mesmo usuario, mesmo dia

    outro.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/view")
    third = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/view").json()
    assert len(third) == len(second) + 1

"""V2-EDI-01..04 — listagem, criacao, edicao, fases, encerramento e remocao."""
from datetime import date, timedelta


def _fmt(d):
    return f"{d.isoformat()}T12:00:00"


def test_criar_edict(make_edict):
    edict = make_edict()
    assert edict["id"]
    assert edict["title"].startswith("Edital teste")
    assert edict["year"] == 2027
    assert edict["semester"] == 1
    assert edict["edict_type"] == "mestrado"
    assert edict["is_open"] is True


def test_criar_edict_datas_fora_de_ordem(admin):
    base = date.today()
    forms = admin.get("/forms").json()
    payload = {
        "title": "Fora de ordem", "description": "x", "year": 2027, "semester": 1,
        "edict_type": "mestrado", "is_open": True,
        "candidate_forms": forms[0]["id"],
        "recommenders_forms": forms[1]["id"] if len(forms) > 1 else forms[0]["id"],
        "date_application": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=3)),
        "date_verification": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=1)),
        "date_evaluation": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=2)),
        "date_closed": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=4)),
    }
    r = admin.post("/edicts", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422


def test_get_edict_completo(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict()
    r = admin.get(f"/edicts/{created['id']}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    detail = r.json()
    assert detail["id"] == created["id"]
    assert detail["title"] == created["title"]
    assert detail["phase"] == "inscricoes"
    assert len(detail["phases"]) == 4
    assert {p["phase"] for p in detail["phases"]} == {
        "inscricoes", "homologacao", "avaliacao", "encerrado"
    }
    assert detail["slots"] == "0"
    assert str(detail["candidate_form_id"]) != ""


def test_listar_edicts(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict(edict_type="doutorado")
    items = admin.get("/edicts").json()
    assert any(e["id"] == created["id"] for e in items)
    for e in items:
        for key in ("id", "title", "year", "semester", "edict_type", "is_open"):
            assert key in e
    filtrado = admin.get("/edicts", params={"type": "doutorado"}).json()
    assert all(e["edict_type"] == "doutorado" for e in filtrado)
    abertos = admin.get("/edicts", params={"is_open": True}).json()
    assert all(e["is_open"] for e in abertos)
    ambos = admin.get("/edicts", params={"type": "doutorado", "is_open": True}).json()
    assert all(e["edict_type"] == "doutorado" and e["is_open"] for e in ambos)


def test_editar_edict(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict()
    base = date.today()
    payload = {
        "title": "Titulo editado",
        "description": "Nova descricao",
        "year": "2028",
        "semester": "2",
        "edict_type": "doutorado",
        "date_application": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=10)),
        "date_verification": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=11)),
        "date_evaluation": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=12)),
        "date_closed": _fmt(base + timedelta(days=13)),
    }
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{created['id']}/edit", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    detail = admin.get(f"/edicts/{created['id']}").json()
    assert detail["title"] == "Titulo editado"
    assert detail["year"] == 2028
    assert detail["semester"] == 2
    assert detail["type"] == "doutorado"


def test_editar_apenas_data(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict()
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{created['id']}/edit-date", json={"closed_date": "2027-06-30"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["closed_date"] == "2027-06-30"


def test_avancar_fase_propaga_forms(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict()
    detail = admin.get(f"/edicts/{created['id']}").json()
    homologacao = next(p for p in detail["phases"] if p["phase"] == "homologacao")
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{created['id']}/advance-phase", json={"id": homologacao["id"]})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == homologacao["id"]
    assert body["label"] == "homologacao"
    assert admin.get(f"/edicts/{created['id']}").json()["phase"] == "homologacao"
    # propagacao para o Forms
    forms = admin.get("/forms").json()
    form = next(f for f in forms if f["id"] == created["candidate_forms"])
    assert form["phase"] == "Approval"


def test_encerrar_edict(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict()
    r = admin.patch(f"/edicts/{created['id']}/close", json={
        "confirmation_deadline": "2027-03-01", "send_approval_letter": False,
    })
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert admin.get(f"/edicts/{created['id']}").json()["is_open"] is False
    again = admin.patch(f"/edicts/{created['id']}/close", json={
        "confirmation_deadline": "2027-03-01", "send_approval_letter": False,
    })
    assert again.status_code == 409


def test_remover_edict(admin, make_edict):
    created = make_edict()
    r = admin.delete(f"/edicts/{created['id']}/remove")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert admin.get(f"/edicts/{created['id']}").status_code == 404
    assert all(e["id"] != created["id"] for e in admin.get("/edicts").json())

"""V2-MAI-01..03 — correcao, formulario de aceite e carta."""
import os
import time

import httpx
import pytest


def _smtp_client():
    url = os.environ["CARONTE_SMTP_API"].rstrip("/")
    return httpx.Client(base_url=url, timeout=60, verify=False)


def _find_message(to_email, contains=None, timeout=30):
    with _smtp_client() as c:
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            r = c.get("/api/Messages")
            for m in r.json():
                if to_email in str(m.get("to", "")):
                    if contains is None:
                        return m
                    raw = c.get(f"/api/Messages/{m['id']}/raw")
                    if contains in raw.text:
                        return m
            time.sleep(1)
    return None


def test_reesend_submission(admin, submission_ctx, phase_id):
    edict, sub = submission_ctx
    admin.post(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/advance-phase", json={"id": phase_id(edict["id"], "homologacao")})
    detail = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()
    email = detail["summary"]["email"]

    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/reesend_submission", json={"text": "Corrigir o anexo"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"]
    assert body["email_sent"]

    msg = _find_message(email, contains="Corrigir o anexo")
    assert msg, f"mensagem de correcao nao recebida para {email}"
    with _smtp_client() as c:
        raw = c.get(f"/api/Messages/{msg['id']}/raw").text
    assert "/form/" in raw


def test_reesend_restrito_a_administrativos(api, admin, submission_ctx, phase_id):
    edict, sub = submission_ctx
    admin.post(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/advance-phase", json={"id": phase_id(edict["id"], "homologacao")})
    r = api.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/reesend_submission", json={"text": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 403


def _approve(admin, sub_id):
    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub_id}/select", json={"stats": "approved", "user_ids": [2]})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text


def _edict_com_aceite(admin):
    """Procura um edital cujo formulario de aceite esteja configurado."""
    for e in admin.get("/edicts").json():
        r = admin.get(f"/edicts/{e['id']}/submissions")
        subs = r.json()["submissions"]
        if not subs:
            continue
        sub = subs[0]
        _approve(admin, sub["id"])
        resp = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/send-accept")
        if resp.status_code == 200:
            return e, sub, resp.json()
    pytest.fail("nenhum edital com formulario de aceite configurado")


def test_send_accept(admin):
    _, sub, body = _edict_com_aceite(admin)
    assert body["message"]
    assert body["email_sent"]

    detail = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()
    accept = detail["summary"]["accept"]
    assert accept["sent"] in ("sent", "replied")

    # repetir nao cria outro envio
    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/send-accept")
    assert r.status_code == 400


def test_send_accept_nao_aprovado(admin, submission_ctx):
    _, sub = submission_ctx
    admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/select", json={"stats": "underreview", "user_ids": None})
    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/send-accept")
    assert r.status_code in (400, 404)


def test_send_letter(admin, submission_ctx):
    _, sub = submission_ctx
    _approve(admin, sub["id"])
    detail = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()
    email = detail["summary"]["email"]
    name = detail["summary"]["name"]

    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/send-letter")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"]
    assert body["email_sent"]

    msg = _find_message(email, contains=name)
    assert msg, f"carta nao recebida por {email}"

    assert admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}").json()["summary"]["letter_sent"] is True
    # repetir nao envia outra carta
    assert admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/send-letter").status_code == 400


def test_send_letter_nao_aprovado(admin, submission_ctx):
    _, sub = submission_ctx
    admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/select", json={"stats": "refused", "user_ids": None})
    r = admin.post(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/send-letter")
    assert r.status_code == 400

"""V2-MAP-01..03 — mapeamentos por tipo e versao."""
import uuid


def _tree(admin, form_id, version=None):
    params = {"version": version} if version else {}
    sections = admin.get(f"/forms/{form_id}/sections", params=params).json()
    assert sections
    section = sections[0]
    fields = admin.get(f"/forms/{form_id}/sessions/{section['id']}/fields").json()
    assert fields
    return {
        "grupo": {
            "campo": {"section": section["id"], "field": fields[0]["id"]},
            "nao_mapeado": None,
        }
    }


def _form_ids(admin, edict):
    detail = admin.get(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}").json()
    return int(detail["candidate_form_id"]), int(detail["recommender_form_id"])


def test_criar_mapeamento_candidato(admin, edict):
    form_id, _ = _form_ids(admin, edict)
    tree = _tree(admin, form_id, 1)
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"]
    mappings = admin.get(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings").json()
    assert any(m["id"] == body["id"] for m in mappings)


def test_criar_mapeamento_recommender(admin, edict):
    _, rec_id = _form_ids(admin, edict)
    tree = _tree(admin, rec_id, 1)
    r = admin.post(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/recommenders/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text

def test_atualizar_e_excluir_mapeamento(admin, edict):
    form_id, _ = _form_ids(admin, edict)
    tree = _tree(admin, form_id, 1)
    created = admin.post(
        f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/", json=tree
    ).json()
    mapping_id = created["id"]

    sections = admin.get(f"/forms/{form_id}/sections", params={"version": 1}).json()
    fields = admin.get(f"/forms/{form_id}/sessions/{sections[0]['id']}/fields").json()
    new_tree = {"outro": {"x": {"section": sections[0]["id"], "field": fields[-1]["id"]}}}
    r = admin.put(
        f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mapping_id}",
        json=new_tree,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    mappings = admin.get(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings").json()
    stored = next(m for m in mappings if m["id"] == mapping_id)
    assert stored["mapping"] == new_tree or stored.get("tree") == new_tree

    r = admin.delete(
        f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mapping_id}"
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == {"message": "Mapping deleted successfully"}
    mappings = admin.get(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings").json()
    assert all(m["id"] != mapping_id for m in mappings)

    # combinacao inexistente
    r = admin.delete(f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings/versions/1/{mapping_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 404
    r = admin.put(
        f"/edicts/{edict['id']}/candidates/mappings/versions/7/{mapping_id}",
        json=new_tree,
    )
    assert r.status_code == 404

"""V2-AUT-02 — fluxo completo da Senha Unnica contra o provedor local."""
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import pytest


def _start(client):
    r = client.post("/auth/login/senhaunica")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert "redirect_to" in body
    return body["redirect_to"]


def _authorize(provedor, redirect_to, perfil):
    qs = parse_qs(urlparse(redirect_to).query)
    token = qs["oauth_token"][0]
    r = provedor.get(
        "/wsusuario/oauth/authorize",
        params={"oauth_token": token, "perfil": perfil},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()


def _callback(client, oauth_token, oauth_verifier):
    r = client.post(
        "/auth/login/senhaunica",
        data={"oauth_token": oauth_token, "oauth_verifier": oauth_verifier},
    )
    if r.status_code == 422:
        r = client.post(
            "/auth/login/senhaunica",
            json={"oauth_token": oauth_token, "oauth_verifier": oauth_verifier},
        )
    return r


def test_fluxo_docente(senhaunica, provedor):
    redirect_to = _start(senhaunica)
    auth = _authorize(provedor, redirect_to, "docente")
    r = _callback(senhaunica, auth["oauth_token"], auth["oauth_verifier"])
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    user = r.json()
    assert user["role"] == "teacher"
    for key in ("id", "name", "email", "nusp", "role"):
        assert key in user
    # sessao valida em requisicoes seguintes
    assert senhaunica.get("/edicts").status_code == 200


def test_novo_usuario_whitelist_cadastra_docente(senhaunica, provedor):
    redirect_to = _start(senhaunica)
    auth = _authorize(provedor, redirect_to, "novo")
    r = _callback(senhaunica, auth["oauth_token"], auth["oauth_verifier"])
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    assert r.json()["role"] == "teacher"


def test_fora_da_whitelist_negado(senhaunica, provedor):
    redirect_to = _start(senhaunica)
    auth = _authorize(provedor, redirect_to, "negado")
    r = _callback(senhaunica, auth["oauth_token"], auth["oauth_verifier"])
    assert r.status_code in (401, 403)


def test_callback_sem_segredo_de_sessao(senhaunica, provedor):
    redirect_to = _start(senhaunica)
    auth = _authorize(provedor, redirect_to, "docente")
    # outra sessao, sem o segredo do request token
    import httpx
    url = senhaunica.base_url
    with httpx.Client(base_url=url, timeout=60, verify=False) as outra:
        r = _callback(outra, auth["oauth_token"], auth["oauth_verifier"])
    assert r.status_code == 401


def test_cookie_de_sessao(senhaunica):
    r = senhaunica.post("/auth/login/senhaunica")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    cookie = r.headers.get("set-cookie", "")
    assert "samesite=lax" in cookie.lower()
    assert "secure" in cookie.lower()

def _walk_files(node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        if node.get("type") == "File" and node.get("value"):
            yield node
        for v in node.values():
            yield from _walk_files(v)
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for v in node:
            yield from _walk_files(v)


def test_baixar_anexo(admin, submission_ctx):
    _, sub = submission_ctx

    files = list(_walk_files(detail["submission_form"]))
    assert files, "fixture data must contain file fields with values"
    field = files[0]
    label = field.get("name") or field.get("label")
    filename = field["value"]
    r = admin.get(f"/submissions/{sub['id']}/files/{label}/{filename}")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    assert r.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/pdf")
    assert "attachment" in r.headers.get("content-disposition", "")
    assert r.content
